top5.titleOriginal: Peter Max, Icon of Psychedelic Art, Dies at 88
top5.titleKo: Peter Max, Icon of Psychedelic Art, Dies at 88
top5.summaryKo: Peter Max, whose trippy Day-Glo paintings came to symbolize the Flower Power era of the 1960s, died on September 18 in a hospital in New York at the age of eighty-eight. He had previously suffered from Alzheimer’s-related dementia. His death was confirmed by his son, Adam Max, and by Park West Galle
